name: The.Thend.End
source:
It's a story where you play as a guy who goes to a psychologist to deal with his problems. But then suddenly, out of nowhere, completely unexpectedly... very interesting things happen and adventure begins!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/988890/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在这个故事中，你扮演一个去找心理学家解决问题的人。但突然间，不知从何而来，完全出乎意料……非常有趣的事情发生了，冒险开始了！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/988890/]Steam[/url]]
